results.name: Nothing is added to the cart that the customer did not choose
results.objective: Add the Cotton Tee to the cart. Then, on the cart page, do not click, tick or untick anything. Only read the Total shown on the cart page and assert it equals ₹548.
results.fix: Leave every paid add-on (plans, insurance, donations) unticked and out of the cart until the customer chooses it.
law: India: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 (2) Basket sneaking
EU: Consumer Rights Directive Art. 22 (no pre-ticked boxes for extra payments)
US: FTC Act Sec. 5 (unfair or deceptive practices)
results.summary:

Viewed the cart total without changing any cart options.
The total shown was ₹548.

results.name: Any countdown is a real deadline
results.objective: On the home page, look for a countdown or 'deal ends' timer. If there is none, assert that no countdown is shown. If there is one, read the time left, wait 20 seconds, reload the page, and read the time left again. Assert that the time left after reloading is at least 15 seconds lower than the first reading.
results.fix: Only show a countdown for a real deadline that keeps counting down for everyone; never restart it on reload.
law: India: CCPA Dark Patterns Guidelines 2023, Annexure 1 (1) False urgency
EU: Unfair Commercial Practices Directive, Annex I point 7 (false 'limited time' claims)
